reviews.comment:
La gente que carga nafta es muy lenta, se ponen a cobrar en vez de dejar cargando los autos, poco sentido de lo que implica parar a cargar nafta en un viaje. Ni hablar del comedor full, no tienen comida lista (a las 13hs) y estuvimos 15 minutos sin que nos atiendan.

(Translated by Google)
The gas station attendants are incredibly slow; they start collecting payment instead of letting cars fill up, showing little regard for the importance of stopping for gas during a trip. And the diner was packed—they didn't have any food ready (at 1 PM) and we waited 15 minutes without being served.
